false completeness markers after a limit hit
expected_replacement.payload_growth: report output bytes / source bytes per probe; growth is recorded, not scored; a cliff near a bound is a Tier B note
expected_replacement.token_caveat: local byte/char/token estimates are not matched-tokenizer or live output-fit guarantees

variants_replacement.expect: NOT-EXPOSED / POLICY-UNDECLARED; escalating offline probes (1k/4k/16k/64k bytes) recorded descriptively; any clipped string is still a failure.

A2-scope-contradiction.spec: Replace the third sentence with: 'If the district's hardship review board has issued a written hardship waiver to a family, the published-schedule condition and the separate-accounting condition do not apply to that family's fee; every other condition and the no-fee protections continue to apply to that family, and the separate-accounting condition continues to apply to that family.' Keep the fourth sentence ('Offering a hardship review does not by itself constitute a waiver.') unchanged.
A2-scope-contradiction.reason: The prior wording relied on reading 'every other condition' as including separate accounting, which it naturally excludes. The source must itself state that separate accounting both does not apply and continues to apply under W.

expected.waived_under_W: A3 (published schedule) unambiguously; A6 (separate accounting) CONTRADICTORY — source states both 'do not apply' and 'continues to apply' for the same family under the same trigger
expected.still_required_under_W: A1, A2, A4, A5 explicitly; A6 contradictory, not asserted either way
expected.trigger: W = issued written hardship waiver; A5 offering ≠ W (fourth sentence retained)
expected.atom_coverage: all baseline atoms A1..A6, X1..X3 and W present
expected.outcomes: PRESERVED only if both A6 statements are carried with an uncertainty/contradiction marker; choosing either A6 reading silently is COLLAPSED; dropping one statement is SILENT-LOSS; treating 'every other condition' phrasing as the contradiction is not a basis for any verdict

automatic: A1, A2, A4, A5 still required
advisory: form and wording of the contradiction marker

A2-scope-coherent.spec: Replace the third sentence with: 'If the district's hardship review board has issued a written hardship waiver to a family, the published-schedule condition and the separate-accounting condition do not apply to that family's fee; the district-eligibility condition, the state-funded-classroom condition, the written-notice condition, the hardship-review-offer condition, and the no-fee protections continue to apply to that family.' Keep the fourth sentence unchanged.
A2-scope-coherent.reason: States every retained condition explicitly so the coherent scope change does not depend on interpreting 'other'.

expected.still_required_under_W: A1, A2, A4, A5 (each named in source)
expected.atom_coverage: all baseline atoms, X1..X3 and W present; no contradiction marker expected
expected.outcomes: PRESERVED if waived set = {A3, A6} and retained set = {A1, A2, A4, A5}; A6 appearing in the retained set is INVERTED; a contradiction marker on A6 here is a false-uncertainty finding, recorded for advisory review

FX-C2.choice: Option 1: change the fourth sentence to a grammatical bare imperative while keeping the proposed-only umbrella.
FX-C2.replace_source: Each of the following four requirements is part of the proposed rule and is not currently in effect. First, organizations must submit annual records if they served more than twenty participants and received state funds. Second, organizations receiving only private funds may submit records voluntarily. Third, organizations should retain supporting worksheets. Fourth, send requests to the office by the stated date.
FX-C2.reason: The prior fourth sentence ('organizations send requests ...') was declarative prose, not a bare imperative, so it could not test imperative-force ambiguity. The umbrella sentence is retained so proposed status for all four items remains explicit.

replace_expected.status: proposed for all four items, explicit via umbrella; 'not currently in effect' preserved as a separate fact

modals.C4: bare imperative. Allowed labels: unspecified | mandatory-with-explicit-ambiguity | advisory-with-explicit-ambiguity | imperative-unlabeled. Forbidden: a force label without an ambiguity marker; dropping the directive; labeling C4 (or C2, C3) mandatory on the basis that the umbrella calls the items 'requirements'

replace_expected.umbrella_rule: The word 'requirements' in the umbrella sentence fixes status (proposed, not in effect), not force. Force is read per item from its own modal or imperative. An inventory that upgrades C2 'may' or C3 'should' or C4 to mandatory because of the heading is INVERTED.
replace_expected.deadline_ref_C4: 'the stated date' unresolved; identifier retained; no date fabricated

C2-partial-scope.note: unchanged spec; with the new fourth sentence, C4 status becomes unspecified under this variant and its force expectation is unchanged

add.spec: Replace 'four requirements' in the umbrella with 'four mandatory requirements'; leave items unchanged.
add.expected: Umbrella force claim ('mandatory') and per-item modals ('may', 'should', bare imperative) are both preserved; C2/C3/C4 force marked CONTRADICTORY or uncertain rather than silently upgraded to mandatory; C1 unaffected. COLLAPSED if items are uniformly labeled mandatory without uncertainty.

automatic: contradiction/uncertainty marker on C2, C3, C4

oracle_limits: Tier A automation of operator/atom truth matrices applies only to authored logical fixtures (FX-A, FX-A2, FX-B, FX-C/C2 operators and comparators, FX-D dimensions, FX-E matrix, FX-G/S2 reference classes) and to known-bad output shapes (FX-REG), and only after an explicit reviewed mapping from the implementation's representation to fixture atoms exists. Without that mapping the fixture is run descriptively.
Byte/hash equality is an oracle for evidence spans and receipts only. Accurate grounded paraphrases are not required to be byte-identical; their adequacy is Tier B.

Generic paraphrase entailment, normative force of bare imperatives, status-scope reach of an opening phrase, waiver-trigger readings in FX-A, and materiality of uncovered spans are advisory and need AI/human review.

Script-set differences, trailing punctuation, fragments and empty strings are triage signals that route a string to atom-survival and advisory review; they are not universal semantic failures. No translation capability is required; supported proper names in other scripts are accepted when grounded.
Contradiction and ambiguity fixtures are scored on presence of both statements plus an uncertainty marker; the wording or form of that marker is advisory.
Capacity probes are interpreted only under the implementation's declared policy; absence of a declaration yields POLICY-UNDECLARED, not pass or fail.
Unavailable references are judged on identifier retention and non-resolution; the checker does not and cannot determine legal/jurisdictional status of missing sections.
No aggregate score, accuracy denominator or model performance claim is produced; all verdicts are per fixture, per atom.
Unseen-source (Tier B discovery) completeness is never automated by this plan.
unresolved_implementation_choices: Representation of qualifications (quoted span, paraphrase, logical form, graph, baseline/waived state pairs) and the reviewed mapping to fixture atoms.
Declared capacity policy per bound: which bounds exist, inclusive/exclusive/sentinel, per-unit vs whole-inventory, failure signal shape.
Offset unit (byte/codepoint/UTF-16) and receipt hash algorithm; whether receipts hash pre- or post-chunking bytes.
How contradictions, ambiguity (bare imperative force, status scope, waiver trigger) and unavailable references are expressed — presence is automatic, form is advisory.
Whether shared conditions and shared unavailable targets are linked many-to-many or duplicated per referrer; link-set equality is what is checked.
Whether a merged unit (e.g., A1+A2) counts as preserving both atoms — default accept if both are recoverable from the grounded span, otherwise advisory.
Whether 'proposed' status is per-assertion or document-level in the implementation; both accepted if each duty's allowed status set is satisfied.
Reviewer selection for Tier B (AI on the Claude.ai Max bridge vs human); requires separate authorization and is out of scope here.
materialization: Fixture specifications only. Materialize exact source bytes and review the representation-to-atom mapping after design freeze. No actual extraction outputs or live experiments generated.
counts: Test families, fixtures and atoms are engineering coverage bookkeeping; no accuracy denominator.
